referee: independent referee 1 of 3 (punctured-window step stability, two-child branching, dead band)

2_two_child_step_at_D_zero.note: 'Two spines total, branching one thereafter' is TRUE, and the derived reason - which the document does not state - is that the puncture stratum is a SOURCE with no incoming edges: the far-depth map is the constant map D -> d(s) > 0, so no child of any member ever has far-depth 0. Stratifying f_0 (D=0) and f_+ (band): f_+(s) <= f_+(s/K) + F_+(s) and f_0(s) <= 2 f_+(s/K) + F_0(s), with f_0 never on a right-hand side. The dependency graph is a path, not a tree; f_0 is evaluated at the top scale only. That is exactly section 5's arithmetic (ratio 1/sqrt(K) = 0.4472, sum factor 1.8090, base multiplicity 2) and it is correct UNDER THIS STRATIFICATION. Counts over j levels: anchored members 1 (root) then exactly 2 per level, total 1 + 2J; full-plane-priced segments (K-2) at the root plus (K-1) per stepping band member, total (K-2) + 2(J-1)(K-1) = O(K log_K l) with J = (1-c) log_K l. No 2^j growth in the visited tree - CONFIRMED as printed. THE OWED SENTENCE: read literally, the document's single-symbol sup recursion f(s) := sup over P(s) has coefficient 2 at EVERY level, because P(s) contains a D = 0 member at every s; then section 5's 'ratio 1/sqrt(K)' and 'multiplicity 2' are both wrong. That literal reading still survives, but only just: forcing sum 9.4721 instead of 1.8090 (harmless), base 2^J f(r_0) = l^{0.4306766(1-c) + c} = l^{0.4989954} at c = 0.12, clearing sqrt(l) by 0.001 in the exponent, with break-even at c = 0.1217646 (c = 0.125 would fail). Do not let anyone raise c without re-deriving that line. Free side finding: keeping the level dependence of the crude cost, total touching <= b l^{1-A} (K-1)/K sum_j (2/K)^j = O(b l^{1-A}) with no J-dependence at all, since 2/K = 0.4 < 1 - so A > 1 suffices even under branching 2, and section 2's reconciliation bracket is over-conservative in both directions. A = 2 is taken; nothing moves.

3_dead_band_puncture_necessity.note: The puncture is STILL NECESSARY under the current wiring, and the necessity is ARCHITECTURAL, not an artefact of an estimate - a stronger result than iter-94's. For ANY chain from (0,0) to (D,s') inside H, the last segment ends at the pair's far endpoint, at depth exactly D, and can be typed only two ways: (a) recursed as an anchored class member, which needs an endpoint on the wall, hence D = 0 (then the reflection puts it in the class); or (b) bulk, full-plane priced, which costs crude x P(free geodesic exits H) and needs D at or above the deviation quantile of the last segment's own scale. Recursing an off-wall pair would need near-depth as a THIRD class parameter and a chain from an off-wall near end, which this architecture does not have. So the admissible far-depths are exactly {0} u [quantile, ...] - the punctured window IS the union of the two available typings, and the hole is the set where neither exists. The bottom edge is likewise derived, not chosen: with the uniform K-chain the last segment has scale s'/K, whose quantile at inflation sigma is sigma W_{s'/K} = the printed bottom edge, met with ratio exactly 1.000000. QUANTITATIVE COST OF ADMITTING THE BAND: with D = rho sigma W_{s'/K}, rho in (0,1), the best available exit bound degrades from l^{-A} to l^{-A rho^theta}, so total touching becomes O(b l^{1 - A rho^theta}); the section-3 o(1) claim dies for rho <= A^{-1/theta} (= 0.7071 at A=2, theta=2) and the sqrt(l) MAIN RESULT dies for rho <= (2A)^{-1/theta} (= 0.5000); at theta = 1 the thresholds are 0.5 and 0.25. At D = O(1), rho -> 0, the touching term is Theta(b s') - linear - and the recursion returns A_+(l) = Theta(l) against an asserted O(sqrt(l) polylog): complete collapse. No chain refinement rescues it: the lattice floor eps >= 1 means the quantile can never be pushed below sigma = (A log l/c)^{1/theta}, so a dead band of at least (0, sigma) is intrinsic at every scale for every chain. The v3 re-wiring is irrelevant to this: the far child's far endpoint is the parent's far endpoint by construction, at depth D, in every variant of the chain. WHAT IS NOT NECESSARY, recorded to keep the necessary part sharp: the top-edge constant C_K is a free choice in the constant-depth chain (any constant >= 2^xi = 1.6818 works; C_K = 3.0188 is the on-chord chain's fixed point and is vestigial here) - narrowing it to 2^xi would cut GEOM's bracket from C_K^2 K = 45.57 to 2^{2xi} K = 14.14 and would also dissolve finding 1(i); PER THE NIGHT'S LESSON this is recorded as a HYPOTHESIS, not a recommendation, since C_K also feeds the class tilt bound and [V5-3]. Likewise the height band [s/2,s] is a free choice (the visited tree has s' = s up to rounding).
